I was rather disappointed with my experience here. I had a bubble facial recommended by the team and was assured they used premium products (such as dermatologica) and found out after that the products were bulk purchased drug store ones. My mask just a her hyness one which is about 88 baht at Watson’s and by design does not bubble. As a result it didn’t bubble at all when the machines was attached which somewhat defeats the purpose. The hand and foot massage that was meant to be included with the treatment was less than 5mins total. The practitioner who did my facial was very process driven but didn’t have much client care at all. She flipped the overhead lights on without warning multiple times, didn’t explain any of the process to me and was quite abrupt and a little rough in her movements which came without warning and were therefore startling to someone lying with their eyes closed. The room was freezing and I had to ask for any extra blanket which she bought me but she put it on haphazardly so that my feet were left sticking out and I had to wiggle around to try and cover myself. It was also quite a bit more expensive than other medi-spas so I guess my expectations were a bit higher because of that as well. Honestly couldn’t recommend this place based on this experience.

EDIT: in addition to the below response the clinic also reached out to me with a very professional, kind and sincere message seeking to remedy the situation which I greatly appreciate and believe it speaks highly of their business goals. I hope they will avoid misleading clients on which products are used in the future and wish them all the best.

Wow how should I begin. Honestly, I wasn't planning in advance to do any facial treatment. I had 2 extra free days to spend in Phuket and I didn't really know how to speed that time. I was thinking to go to massage but then I was thinking to check out maybe I can do a facial treatment. I was searching on Google and came across this place. It had a lot of positive reviews so I saved it and I saw that it's very close to my place. So after lunch I thought to pop in and ask them if they have free slots for that day by any chance or next day and ask to see what they can recommend for me. When I arrived I was greeted by the lovely receptionists and suddenly I got the manager talking to me asking me what I'd like to get and looked at my face and gave me her recomandation, even got the doctor coming out and also got her recomandation. They were super nice and patient with me got me some tea and amazingly delicious pumpkin desert 🤤. It took me forever to decide what I wanted because I wasn't planning on it and normally I also do deep research before doing or buying anything. In the end I chose a treatment and straight away they got me to the room and we did the treatment with the bubble gen 9 in 1 machine which is a non invasive treatment rejuvenates, cleanses and lifts the skin. It was a very pleasant experience, I've never done anything like this. They treated me like a princess from the moment I entered until the end, they are very polite and I could feel how genuine they were. They didn't try to push anything on me. I even got hand a foot massage. My skin felt hydrated straight after. It's been 3 weeks now and my skin looks better. I think I saw a difference after 1 week and more after 2 weeks. I also started using Korean sunscreen and pyto retinol after so I am not sure if those helped too. But I definitely think this was a good restart for my skin. After that I really started taking care of my skin and looking after it. So for me it was like a good restart for a better care.

I highly recommend this place, they are very  professional.
